# Science News

> Science News delivers comprehensive coverage of scientific discoveries across all disciplines, from climate and biology to archaeology and neuroscience, with expert reporting from leading science journalists.

Science News is a trusted source for breaking scientific research and discoveries. The site organizes content across major scientific disciplines including life sciences, earth science, health and medicine, and human sciences, with subscription options for full access to in-depth reporting.

## Key Topics

- environmental-science

## Core Navigation

- [Science News Homepage](https://www.sciencenews.org): Homepage featuring latest scientific advances across all areas of science
- [All Topics Directory](https://www.sciencenews.org/topics): Directory of all science topics and article categories on Science News
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.sciencenews.org/subscribe1): Subscription and membership tier options for Science News access

## Life Sciences

- [Life Sciences](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/life): Life sciences news covering animals, plants, evolution, and paleontology
- [Genetics](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/genetics): Genetics news covering heredity, mutation, and evolutionary research
- [Animals](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/animals): Animal biology and wildlife news covering mosquitoes, sharks, and fauna
- [Plants](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/plants): Plant biology news including orchid reproduction and plant behavior
- [Microbes](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/microbes): Microbiology news on microbes, disease surveillance, and soil science
- [Paleontology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/paleontology): Paleontology news on dinosaurs, fossils, and ancient life discovery

## Health & Medicine

- [Health & Medicine](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/health-medicine): Latest news on health, medicine, vaccines, and GLP-1 medications
- [Neuroscience](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/neuroscience): Neuroscience research on brain health, aging, and disease treatment
- [Psychology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/psychology): Psychology and neuroscience news on brain health and mental wellness

## Earth & Climate Sciences

- [Earth Science](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/earth): Earth science news on climate, geology, and planetary systems
- [Climate](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/climate): Climate change and environmental science news on geoengineering impacts
- [Ecosystems](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/ecosystems): Ecosystems and conservation news on climate change and ocean health
- [Oceans](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/oceans): Ocean science news on marine life, sea levels, and climate impacts
- [Agriculture](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/agriculture): Agricultural science news on crop disease, pest management, and farming

## Human Sciences

- [Humans](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/humans): News on anthropology, health, archaeology, and human migration
- [Anthropology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/anthropology): Anthropology news covering human evolution and early human migration
- [Archaeology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/archaeology): Archaeology coverage including Monte Verde and fossil discoveries
